title: Emit shared-port fusion and bound its free five-target completion (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Emit the actual five-bank shared-port construction proposed in #4813 using #4743's dirty-input native interface, then prove a scoped ceiling for completing its unchanged endpoint. Four contiguous pure-word segments satisfy `AD=NK` with unit-phase monomial N. Their literal fusion changes 14 rank-one children to **two rank-one plus four rank-three children**, with 24 monomial and 10 ADD passes. Both words and the actual raw inverse transpose are retained.

The endpoint is coupled:

```text
u0=x0; uj=D xj+B u(j-1), j=1,...,4
outputs=(A² x0+F u4, A u1, A u2, A u3, A u4).
```

The additive completion proof replays all 25 blocks of both literal schedules in the exact absolute-phase Clifford group algebra, retaining scalar coefficients outside tensor powers. The grade-three projection has zero first row and column and a lower four-by-four triangular block with group-unit AD diagonals. Its image from `B_f^5` to `A_(3),f^5` has dimension exactly `4d`; five independent rank-three jobs require `5d`.

Arbitrary rectangular free linear pre/post controllers over the finite columnwise monomial Clifford algebra cannot increase this resource. The bound includes cross-output ADD, clean buffers, copies, dropping, resetting and saved-original-input bypasses. For any five independent Gaussian jobs of ranks at most three, reward is at most `4*3^t+2^t`, against paid recursive cost `4*3^t+2`, so the optimistic moment is at most `2^t-2<=0` for `t=1-C` in [0,1], strictly negative for positive C. No new κ is claimed.

This scope fixes one complete producer invocation and permits pre/post controls. Prefix taps, saved intermediate producer states, interleaved gates, transformed nonmonomial helper resources, changed target inventories and arbitrary width-specific address operations outside the finite columnwise alphabet are excluded. A separate rank-zero proof covers invertible controllers and restored dirty identity scratch. The phase-aware separating-tensor argument is faithful at sufficiently large widths, enough to exclude an all-width completion; accidental small-width equalities are not excluded by that argument.

The original snapshot/reset policy remains an explicit losing construction: 23 rank-one calls, 69 monomial and 23 ADD passes, before final cleanup of five dependent saved fields. No output is credited twice.

The original construction at `0970de4ec97fc942e6202403ffd7586d19559391` is retained byte-for-byte in its 14 scientific/input files. The addendum adds `completion/`, appends README and updates only operational TASK/SOURCES/VERIFY metadata. Its six consumed producer files have exact Git-blob and SHA256 pins. #4920 at `7eb4ef5251f7ba96c7e5d78c42fc98e66b7be4ba` is credited for the projection/phase-aware faithfulness method; it is citation-only, with the needed proof rederived locally.

Original exact predecessors: #4813 `f982ecc06826e7087e69b9468d3ff52589fd0822`; #4743 `158048812f4e0aeb132408f4d7cda57ba008b0d5`; #4628 `ee4fd87f064017c23e5a86fc1dcfe0a5237caed3`. Five original source files retain immutable URLs, Git blobs, hashes and CRLF bytes in ORIGINS.json. Replay does not depend on cached unmerged objects.

[Canonical investigation #4843](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4843) retains the completed construction and direct-binding history. #4842 supplies the distinct complete-cascade conditioning/admission audit. #4841's changed-chart compiler does not emit or complete this word. #4908, frozen at `7662641e7016a3e38826fd5a9e73c30db751452b`, supplies a useful rounded cyclic inverse once its actual observation contract is met; a direct substitution into this producer fails, and the addendum now covers the broader linear pre/post completion question within its stated alphabet. #4919's shared-subspace classification concerns another native-map lever. Recent live submissions through #4926 were inspected; no overlapping five-bank completion proof was found in this bounded coverage. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhausted.

No advance claim is invented for this short read/derive extension. It closes the existing PR's documented open question in a declared model and is added to that same PR.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/block3-shared-port-composition
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/block3-shared-port-composition --check-source-history
python3 -I -W error -B research/block3-shared-port-composition/completion/check_grade.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/block3-shared-port-composition/completion/check_grade.py
```

Python3.12/Linux, standard library only. Original checks cover all 40 width-one basis columns, 14 width-two basis columns and dirty vectors; raw/fused words, the independent recurrence, literal reverses, raw inverse transpose and all 1,600 width-one bilinear entries agree. Existing optimized corruption checks reject source changes, a raw-dual ADD-sign change and false κ receipts.

The additive checker expands both complete schedules in the exact group algebra and compares every block. M00 has 33 raw terms, 32 absolute/projective classes, six grade-zero and 26 grade-two terms; its unique coefficient-one X0 class survives every central-character specialization. It checks the full grade table, unit diagonals and explicit pricing inequality. Actual ADD-sign and omitted-closing-Gaussian mutations fail endpoint binding. Separate normal/optimized agent review reproduced the source expansion, Clifford primitives and rank-three argument without a correctness finding. These bounded computations corroborate the written all-width proof, rather than extrapolating it from width one.

Local registered commands, committed-byte/source-history, official export/integrity, Git-free optimized replay and input-integrity checks: all five registered commands passed; 36 committed/exported files stayed unchanged, and both old and new optimized scientific checks passed from a Git-free archive with PATH=/nonexistent. Eight additional normal/optimized actual source, WORD and receipt mutation replays passed. Earlier [CI run39862166892](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39862166892) passed at the original construction head `0970de4ec97fc942e6202403ffd7586d19559391`; it does not certify the addendum. Additive [hosted run39877471875](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39877471875) **passed** at exact head `349da4715df7414eb83b5867e095dcc48eb06dbb`:346 helper tests with11 expected skips, all five registered commands and the committed-input integrity gate. Registered outcome remains negative-result; hosted success does not establish a profitable endpoint or new κ.

No complete native phase suite, selected cold replay, Lean, complete caller/compiler/outer admission or independent human review was performed. Scalar, routing, storage and precision bills retain their separate obligations; no recursive-rank conversion is assumed. The local output-only handoff and run receipts in `completion/` are archived evidence; README gives the published reproduction paths.

## Open next questions

The fixed-word free pre/post completion search is stopped in the declared alphabet. A useful next experiment must change a priced resource: the paid word/profile, interleaving or prefix-access policy, a completely inventoried nonmonomial helper resource, independent target census, or address grammar. Derive its optimistic complete-cost screen before implementation. A physically valid priced witness, a profitable complete caller, and funded κ above #4610's conditional .0030217758 remain separate milestones. Compiler reserve and outer transfer must be funded before any κ claim.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. Shared code, predecessor scientific bytes and selected records remain unchanged.
